row.body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says violet powder came from the well-water study; the mice abandoned the bin before the nurse stopped taking calls.
row.title: weathered bundle note — after monday supper

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the violet powder while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
